Generate or Coerce to an Equation List

Source: R/eqnClass.R
eqnlist.Rd

An eqnlist stores an ODE as a stoichiometric matrix, rate expressions, state names and compartment information. eqnlist() builds one from these parts, as.eqnlist() from a data frame of reactions.

Usage

as.eqnlist(data, volumes, ...)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
as.eqnlist(
  data,
  volumes = NULL,
  compartments = NULL,
  compartmentOf = NULL,
  reactionCompartment = NULL,
  amountStates = NULL,
  ...
)

is.eqnlist(x)

eqnlist(
  smatrix = NULL,
  states = colnames(smatrix),
  rates = NULL,
  volumes = NULL,
  description = NULL,
  compartments = NULL,
  compartmentOf = NULL,
  reactionCompartment = NULL,
  amountStates = NULL,
  totals = NULL
)

Arguments

data

data frame with the columns "Description", "Rate" and one column per state.

volumes

named character of state volumes. Without compartmentOf, each distinct expression becomes a compartment with ID c1, c2, ..., and compartments is ignored. With compartmentOf, the compartment layout wins, and a volume that differs from it gives a warning.

...

not used.

compartments

named list keyed by compartment ID; each entry is a volume expression (character) or a list with fields volume and rule (dV/dt, see setCompartmentVolume()).

compartmentOf

named character vector mapping states to compartment IDs. States not listed default to compartment "defaultComp" with volume "1". May also name states that do not exist yet; see assignCompartment().

reactionCompartment

character of length nrow(smatrix), the compartment in whose frame each rate is given; NA infers it from the educts. Required for reactions whose educts span several compartments. Default NULL.

amountStates

character, the states given in amounts rather than concentrations (SBML's hasOnlySubstanceUnits). Their fluxes are not divided by a compartment volume. Default NULL.

x

object to test.

smatrix

numeric stoichiometric matrix, one row per reaction and one column per state. Default NULL gives an empty equation list.

states

character, the state names. Default colnames(smatrix).

rates

character, the rate expressions, one per reaction.

description

character, one description per reaction. Default NULL numbers the reactions.

totals

named list of user-defined conservation expressions, stored without the checks of customTotals(). conservedQuantities() returns them; steadyStates() ignores them, and addReaction(), assignCompartment(), setCompartmentVolume(), subset() and c() drop them, as they keep only totals set by customTotals(). Default NULL uses the detected basis.

Value

Object of class eqnlist, a list with the entries above and the per-state volumes. is.eqnlist() returns a logical.

Details

The data frame for as.eqnlist() contains the columns "Description" (character), "Rate" (character) and one column per state, the columns of the stoichiometric matrix. Layout attributes of the data frame, as set by as.data.frame.eqnlist(), fill in the layout arguments not given; with volumes given, the attributes compartments and compartmentOf are not used.

See also

addReaction(), as.eqnlist(), assignCompartment(), setCompartmentVolume()

Examples

# Generate eqnlist from the constructor
S <- matrix(c(-1, 1, 1, -1),
            nrow = 2, ncol = 2,
            dimnames = list(NULL, c("A", "B")))

rates <- c("k1*A", "k2*B")
description <- c("forward", "backward")

f <- eqnlist(smatrix = S, rates = rates, description = description)
print(f)
#> Conserved quantities:
#>   total_1 = 1*A+1*B
#> 
#>   Check Educt -> Product Rate Description
#> 1           A ->       B k1*A     forward
#> 2           B ->       A k2*B    backward

# Convert to data.frame
fdata <- as.data.frame(f)
print(fdata)
#>   Description Rate  A  B
#> 1     forward k1*A -1  1
#> 2    backward k2*B  1 -1

# Flat `volumes`: each distinct expression becomes a compartment c1, c2, ...
f <- as.eqnlist(fdata, volumes = c(A = "Vcyt", B = "Vnuc"))
print(f)
#> Conserved quantities:
#>   total_1 = 1*Vcyt*A+1*Vnuc*B
#> 
#> Compartments:
#>   c1 (V=Vcyt)
#>   c2 (V=Vnuc)
#> States by compartment:
#>   c1: A
#>   c2: B
#> 
#>   Check Educt -> Product Rate Description
#> 1           A ->       B k1*A     forward
#> 2           B ->       A k2*B    backward
print(as.eqnvec(f))
#> Idx Inner <- Outer
#>   1     A <- -1*(k1*A)+1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc/Vcyt)
#>   2     B <- 1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt/Vnuc)-1*(k2*B)
print(as.eqnvec(f, type = "amount"))
#> Idx Inner <- Outer
#>   1     A <- -1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt)+1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc)
#>   2     B <- 1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt)-1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc)

# Named compartments with explicit state assignment
f2 <- eqnlist(
  smatrix = S, rates = rates, description = description,
  compartments = list(cyt = "Vcyt", nuc = "Vnuc"),
  compartmentOf = c(A = "cyt", B = "nuc")
)
print(f2)
#> Conserved quantities:
#>   total_1 = 1*Vcyt*A+1*Vnuc*B
#> 
#> Compartments:
#>   cyt (V=Vcyt)
#>   nuc (V=Vnuc)
#> States by compartment:
#>   cyt: A
#>   nuc: B
#> 
#>   Check Educt -> Product Rate Description
#> 1           A ->       B k1*A     forward
#> 2           B ->       A k2*B    backward
print(as.eqnvec(f2))
#> Idx Inner <- Outer
#>   1     A <- -1*(k1*A)+1*(k2*B)*(Vnuc/Vcyt)
#>   2     B <- 1*(k1*A)*(Vcyt/Vnuc)-1*(k2*B)
